hook.name: ArtPegHook
hook.description: A three-phase token launchpad hook: CURVE phase prices via a custom bonding curve with ERC-6909 claims settlement (AMM is NoOp'd); REFUND_WINDOW phase allows sells at the buyer's recorded entry price; AMM phase uses full-range liquidity with 100bps platform+creator fee skimming and optional mechanic fees. Includes anti-snipe (3-block delay + same-tx transient lock), exact-input-only enforcement, and a post-graduation TWAP oracle.
